title: Inquest scheduled in Whitelaw death
article: An inquest into the death of a 22-year-old Surrey man in police custody has been scheduled for April 26 to 28 by the B.C. Coroner's service.
Brandon Whitelaw died July 31, 2008 after he was arrested in Whalley.
RCMP were investigating a a notorious crack house in the Ravine Road area when they pulled over a car that Whitelaw was riding in.
Shortly after being handcuffed, Whitelaw started choking.
Ambulance attendants recovered an intact plastic bag from Whitelaw's airway which contained 11 rocks of crack cocaine.
Whitelaw was transported to Surrey Memorial Hospital where he died a short time later.
